scope: VB ListBox multi-selection, sorting, disabled and scroll boundary.
actual_source_basis: The admitted Mouse VB5/VB6 and XP Styles sources contain ordinary ListBox controls.
The AlphaIcon VB5 source uses a ListBox whose Enabled state is changed by application workflow.
renderer_boundary: The existing exact ThunderRT5/6ListBox path handles public list drawing, selection and scrollbar updates. It does not change data ordering, selection or Enabled state; those remain native LISTBOX/VB responsibilities.
result: The existing self-owned runtime regression already covers LBS_EXTENDEDSEL selection and native font/scrollbar ownership. No admitted source shows Sorted or multi-simple selection, so no claim or product extension is made for those unobserved variants.
not_covered: A real admitted Sorted or LBS_MULTIPLESEL sample.
